2.All these appeals are arising from common judgment and award dated 27.07.2017 passed by the Principal Senior Civil Judge, Mahisagar at Lunawada in Land Acquisition Reference(LAR) Case no.637 of 2017 old LAR Caseno.461/2008 to LAR no.648/2017(472/2008).

sentences.text: 3.The brief facts of the case are that the lands of the claimants under reference is situated at Narsingpur, Taluka Santrampur, District Panchmahal now District Mahisagar.
The said land was p r o p o s e d t o b e a c q u i r e d b y t h e S t a t e G o v e r n m e n t f o r t h e c o n s t r u c t i o n o f Lunawada-Santrampur-Zalod bypass road.
4.The notification under Section 4 of the Land NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3071/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/07/2023 undefined Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short "the Act") was published on 16.02.2006.

entities.text: Land NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3071/2023 ORDER DATED:
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Thereafter the notification under Section 6 of the Act was published on 18.08.2006.
Thereafter personal as well as public notice under Section 9 of the Act was also issued.

The Special Land Acquisition Officer after considering the relevant facts awarded the compensation at the rate of Rs.12.110/- per square meter for agriculture land and Rs.168/- per square meter for non-agriculture land in Land Award No.4 of 2005.
The award also included severance charges.

5.Being aggrieved and dissatisfied by the award passed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, the claimants preferred the reference under Section 18 of the Act praying for compensation of Rs.800/-
per square meter.

6.The Reference Court after considering the evidence produced on record, relied upon the award passed in LAR Case no.18 of 1987 for which a notification was issued under Section 4 of the Act on 26.10.1978 i.e. prior to about 27 years and 4 months from the date of notification in the present case issued on NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3071/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/07/2023 undefined 16.02.2006.

7. The Reference Court after considering that the land which was acquired in LAR Case No.18 of 1987 was the nearest land and no other evidence was available with regard to the comparable sale instances, 10% increase in the market value of the agriculture land was considered.
The Reference Court therefore awarded additional compensation of Rs.760/- per square meter with 30% solatium and interest.

8.Learned advocates appearing for both the sides submitted that the Division Bench of this Court in First Appeal Nos.1662 of 2003 to 1682 of 2003 by order dated 12.03.2004 upheld the award passed in LAR Case No.18 of 1987 by dismissing the appeal preferred by the State Government.

entities.text: First Appeal Nos.1662 of 2003 to 1682 of 2003
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 9. It was therefore submitted that as the Reference Court has relied upon the order passed in LAR Case No.18 of 1987 which has been confirmed by the Division Bench of this Court in the aforesaid judgment and award, this appeal would also not survive.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3071/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/07/2023 undefined 10.

Considering the aforesaid submissions, without going into the merits of the matter as the judgment and award in LAR Case no.18 of 1987 is confirmed vide order dated 12.03.2004 passed by the Division Bench of this Court in First Appeal Nos.1662 of 2003 to 1682 of 2003, the appeals would not survive and accordingly the same are ordered to be dismissed.
